name: Snapjaws, Mon!
summary: In the Hinterlands, Katoom the Angler of Revantusk Village can barely keep a line in the water because saltwater snapjaws keep wrecking it and stealing his bait. He wants fifteen of the turtles dead.

sections.title: Trouble on the Line
sections.body: Katoom urges you not to be taken in by the snapjaws' large eyes and calls the turtles a menace. By his account, he cannot fish for even five minutes before one of them tears his line and makes off with his bait. He asks you, as a favor to himself and to his neighbours in the village, to wipe out the whole lot; the count is fifteen.

faq.q: Who asks you to hunt the turtles?
faq.answer: Katoom the Angler, a fisher of Revantusk in the Hinterlands.

faq.q: Why does Katoom want the saltwater snapjaws killed?
faq.answer: Katoom says they break his fishing line and steal his bait, so he cannot fish for even five minutes in peace.

faq.q: How many snapjaws need to be slain?
